purpose: Define request/execution deadlines separately from component-local timeout measurements, with explicit propagation and termination semantics.

topics.name: Execution Deadline and Timeout
topics.purpose: Define request/execution deadlines separately from component-local timeout measurements, with explicit propagation and termination semantics.

semantics.deadline_rule: Absolute/relative deadline and clock profile are explicit.
semantics.timeout_rule: Local timeout derives from exact execution profile and remaining deadline where applicable.
semantics.propagation_rule: Child call deadline never silently exceeds parent deadline unless explicitly detached.
semantics.result_rule: Deadline exceeded is distinct from operation failure/success.
semantics.effect_rule: Timeout does not prove external effect absence.
semantics.retry_rule: Retry policy consumes remaining overall budget.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.
